concept: Fargate: serverless containers with no instance management
tests: Choosing the ECS launch type that eliminates OS patching and cluster capacity planning.
expected: ECS on AWS Fargate — you only set vCPU/memory per task, no EC2 nodes to patch or scale. Triggers: "eliminate server patching", "cluster capacity planning", "staying on ECS", "least operational effort".
why_not: The EC2 launch type (On-Demand or Spot) requires managing an instance fleet; self-managed Kubernetes on EC2 is the maximum operational burden.
